primary_task: Produce a supply-chain risk report (report.md and findings.json) for a project's npm, PyPI or Go dependencies by running the bundled collect.py and render.py scripts with uv, then add a short narrative with upgrade paths and replacement candidates.

requirements.name: uv
requirements.basis: bash: "install packages from the open registries (pip from PyPI, npm, apt from Ubuntu, go modules, nuget, GitHub release downloads)"; egress_allow includes "pypi.org" and "files.pythonhosted.org" (uv is on PyPI)

requirements.name: python
requirements.evidence: scripts/collect.py and scripts/render.py run through uv run
requirements.basis: bash: "run shell commands on Linux x86_64: ... build, test, run CLIs and scripts" (Python is standard on Linux; uv can also fetch one)

requirements.name: package registries (registry.npmjs.org, pypi.org, proxy.golang.org)
requirements.evidence: Generates a supply-chain risk report for a project's direct dependencies (npm, PyPI, Go) / several HTTP requests per dependency / this skill never reads dependency source, only registry, advisory, and repository metadata
requirements.basis: description: "the package registries and hosts pypi (PyPI), npm, GitHub (github.com, api.github.com, raw.githubusercontent.com), Ubuntu (apt archives), NuGet and the Go module proxy are open"

requirements.name: api.github.com
requirements.evidence: Check `gh auth status`. Unauthenticated GitHub allows 60 requests/hour against 5,000 ... expect repository criteria to come back unassessable without it.
requirements.basis: description: "The user's GitHub account is usable through the github connector and through the gh CLI via the proxy."

requirements.name: gh
requirements.basis: bash: "run CLIs and scripts, git, gh"; description: "The user's GitHub account is usable through the github connector and through the gh CLI via the proxy."

requirements.name: advisory database host (not named)
requirements.evidence: version-matched advisories for direct dependencies and the full lockfile tree / only registry, advisory, and repository metadata
requirements.basis: The document does not name the advisory host. egress_allow lists only registry, GitHub, Ubuntu, NuGet, Go and HashiCorp hosts; the _sources note says "hosts not listed are unknown." Would need to check which host collect.py queries for advisories (for example GitHub advisory API, which is open, or another service).

requirements.name: npm downloads statistics host (not named)
requirements.evidence: `gh` saw zero downloads for a package that moves 164 million a week ... Do not estimate maintainer counts, downloads ... run the collector
requirements.basis: The host is not named; egress_allow lists "registry.npmjs.org" and "npmjs.com" only. Would need to check which host the collector uses for download counts.

notes: Unknown statuses (non-blocking): the advisory source host and the npm download-statistics host are not named in the document. If the collector queries a host outside the allow-list for advisories, the advisory criterion would come back unassessable; the document says unavailable data yields 'unassessable-with-a-reason' rather than failure, but also that 'A run that measured nothing exits non-zero', so under a reading where all advisory data is required and its host is refused, the verdict could be BLOCKED. Taken reading: registries and GitHub are open, so the collector can measure and the report can be produced.
